name: 海洋2000
group_note: ES2/jinyong-lineage mudlib, in-game titled 海洋II (Ocean II). Bugs fixed: (1) stale MASTER_OB/SIMUL_EFUN_OB macros pointed at /adm/single/ dead-code duplicates instead of /adm/obj/ (the real files per config.fluffos, §7.56-class); (2) §7.54-class sscanf(read_file(missing_file)) crash in logind.lpc's howmany_visitor()/howmany_card() reading /log/mud/MUDVISITOR and GIFTCARD on a fresh checkout; (3) new §7.54 addendum: write(read_file(missing_file)) crash in uptime.lpc's LASTCRASH display, blocking the id prompt from ever appearing at all (no compile error, no catchable exception -- silently prevented registration from starting); (4) new AGENTS.md §7.63: quit.lpc's new('/clone/topten/magic-rice') was missing the defensive if(ob=new(...)) guard that every sibling call site (top10.lpc, topboard.lpc, topten.lpc, topdel.lpc -- the last of which has a comment acknowledging the exact failure) already has, crashing every quit with a bad call_other on int 0; fixed by matching the sibling pattern rather than chasing the underlying new()-failure root cause (extensive investigation confirmed the file compiles cleanly and create() never even starts executing -- a pre-existing driver/mudlib quirk the original authors already defended against everywhere except this one call site). ADMIN BOOTSTRAP DEVIATES FROM THE USUAL PATTERN: securd.lpc hardcodes a bootstrap admin id 'wuyou' directly in restore_list() (set("wiz_status/wuyou","(admin)")) instead of using the plain-text adm/etc/wizlist file most other libs in this collection use. Admin account registered as id 'wuyou' (Chinese name 无忧) with password Mud@2026, confirmed via visible 目前权限：(admin) display. Full registration->look->score->quit flow verified twice (before and after the LPC formatter pass) with a real Chinese name. Formatter run found 1 file (cmds/usr/setbak.lpc) with genuine corruption inside a heredoc help-text block (every Chinese character respaced) -- reverted via git checkout.
